subject: settlement-attribution

flow.step_1: Agent discovers CSOAI via MCP Registry / awesome-mcp-servers / Glama
flow.step_2: Agent calls councilof.ai/mcp → free tools (verify_card, get_axis, etc.)
flow.step_3: Agent needs paid proof → x402 challenge returned (402 + accepts[] header)
flow.step_4: Agent pays USDC on Base → facilitator verifies → receipt issued
flow.step_5: Attribution: source= MCP_REGISTRY | AWESOME_MCP | GLAMA | DIRECT | PROMOTION
flow.step_6: Receipt includes: payer_address, amount, source, timestamp, proof_sha256

attribution_sources.detection: Payer address matches known promotion wallet

measurement: Each settlement produces a signed receipt with attribution. We measure which distribution surfaces produce paying agents. This IS the product — we measure our own revenue pipeline.
honest_sentence: Attribution tracks where paying agents come from. We measure our own distribution funnel. The 8 promotion seeds (0.08 USDC) prove the rail works; real customer demand is measured separately.
